statement: Manufacture every drug, prescription or over-the-counter, in compliance with current good manufacturing practice requirements.
quote: All drugs must be manufactured in accordance with the current good manufacturing practice regulations
clause: Dosage Form Drug Manufacturers cGMPs (10/93) > GUIDE TO INSPECTIONS OF DOSAGE FORM DRUG MANUFACTURER'S - CGMPR'S > II. CURRENT GOOD ¶11

statement: Keep records relating to prescription drugs readily available for review by FDA during inspection.
quote: Records relating to prescription drugs must be readily available for review
clause: Dosage Form Drug Manufacturers cGMPs (10/93) > GUIDE TO INSPECTIONS OF DOSAGE FORM DRUG MANUFACTURER'S - CGMPR'S > II. CURRENT GOOD ¶11

statement: Use only colors approved for their intended use, and declare the required statements about them on the drug label.
quote: Determine if the color is approved for its intended use, and required statements are declared on the drug label.
clause: Dosage Form Drug Manufacturers cGMPs (10/93) > GUIDE TO INSPECTIONS OF DOSAGE FORM DRUG MANUFACTURER'S - CGMPR'S > II. CURRENT GOOD ¶36

statement: Process powders and granulations according to the firm's own specifications.
quote: determine whether powders or granulations are processed according to the firm's specifications.
clause: Dosage Form Drug Manufacturers cGMPs (10/93) > GUIDE TO INSPECTIONS OF DOSAGE FORM DRUG MANUFACTURER'S - CGMPR'S > II. CURRENT GOOD ¶64

statement: Have HEPA filters in sterile drug operations certified and/or DOP tested, at a defined testing frequency.
quote: Review the firm's system for HEPA filters, determine if they are certified and/or Dioctyl Phthalate (DOP) tested and frequency of testing.
clause: Dosage Form Drug Manufacturers cGMPs (10/93) > GUIDE TO INSPECTIONS OF DOSAGE FORM DRUG MANUFACTURER'S - CGMPR'S > II. CURRENT GOOD ¶73

statement: Filter compressed air used in sterile drug operations at the point of use to control particulates.
quote: Review the compressed air system and determine if it is filtered at the point of use to control particulates.
clause: Dosage Form Drug Manufacturers cGMPs (10/93) > GUIDE TO INSPECTIONS OF DOSAGE FORM DRUG MANUFACTURER'S - CGMPR'S > II. CURRENT GOOD ¶74
